Passing a non-int value (that is not None) for `max_cookies_per_domain` raises `TypeError`.
Passing a negative int for `max_cookies` raises `ValueError`.
Passing a negative int for `max_cookies_per_domain` raises `ValueError`.

contracts.adverse_condition: The new cookie must be the one that would cause the global limit to be exceeded; eviction must occur deterministically among cookies with different creation times.

contracts.text: Per-domain limit eviction is applied before global limit eviction when both limits would be exceeded.
contracts.adverse_condition: A single insertion must trigger both a per-domain overflow and a global overflow simultaneously.

contracts.text: `extract_cookies(response)` reads `Set-Cookie` header(s) from the response and parses them into stored cookies.
Multiple `Set-Cookie` headers on a single response are each parsed independently.
contracts.adverse_condition: The response carries more than one Set-Cookie header.

contracts.text: A single `Set-Cookie` header value that contains multiple comma-separated cookies is split into individual cookies for parsing, while respecting that an `Expires=` attribute may itself contain a comma.
contracts.adverse_condition: The header value contains commas both as cookie separators and inside an Expires date.

contracts.text: Empty cookie strings (zero-length after trimming) are ignored during extraction.
Malformed cookie strings that cannot be parsed as a name-value pair are ignored during extraction.
A cookie is ignored entirely if the `Domain` attribute appears without a value.

contracts.text: Unknown cookie attributes are silently ignored during parsing.
A cookie whose value is the empty string is stored as a valid cookie.
A cookie set without a `Domain` attribute is host-only: it is only sent to the exact host that set it.
contracts.adverse_condition: A request is made to a subdomain or a different host; the cookie must not be included.

contracts.text: A cookie set with a `Domain` attribute is accepted and stored only when the origin host domain-matches the Domain value (case-insensitive suffix match with a leading dot or equivalent).

contracts.text: A cookie with a `Domain` attribute is sent to subdomains of that domain, not only to the exact domain.
contracts.adverse_condition: A request is made to a subdomain of the cookie's Domain; the cookie must be included.

contracts.text: Domain matching is case-insensitive.
contracts.adverse_condition: The request host and the cookie's Domain differ only in letter case.

contracts.text: When no `Path` attribute is present, the default path is derived from the request path that set the cookie.

contracts.text: Path matching: a cookie with path `/sub` is sent to a request whose path is exactly `/sub`.
Path matching: a cookie with path `/sub` is sent to a request whose path is `/sub/x`.
Path matching: a cookie with path `/sub` is NOT sent to a request whose path is `/submarine`.
contracts.adverse_condition: The request path starts with `/sub` but the next character is not `/` or end-of-string.

contracts.text: A cookie with the `Secure` attribute is only sent over HTTPS.
contracts.adverse_condition: The request uses HTTP (not HTTPS).

contracts.text: A cookie whose name starts with `__Host-` is not stored unless the `Secure` attribute is present.

contracts.text: A cookie whose name starts with `__Host-` is not stored unless `Path=/`.

contracts.text: An `Expires` date in the past deletes any existing matching cookie (same name, domain, path).

contracts.text: An unparseable `Expires` value does not prevent the cookie from being stored.
